arch.description: Target architecture (e.g., amd64, arm64). Required only for non-default arch.

configdir.description: Path to custom config directory (for flavour files, etc.).

flavour.description: Bootstrap flavour: standard, minimal, or build.

keyring.description: Filename of GPG keyring to use (relative paths searched in /usr/local/share/keyrings, /usr/share/keyrings, and configdir).

helperdir.description: Path to custom helper directory (e.g., for policy-rc.d scripts).

allow_unauthenticated.description: If true, ignore unauthenticated packages and missing Release.gpg.

download_only.description: If true, download packages but skip installation.

foreign.description: If true, enable bootstrap for non-native architecture (requires qemu-user-static).

include.description: Comma-separated list of extra packages to install (e.g., ['vim', 'curl']).

exclude.description: Comma-separated list of packages to exclude (only effective for explicitly included packages).

quiet.description: If true, suppress most output (warnings and errors only).

verbose.description: If true, show all command output.

target.description: Target directory where the new system is bootstrapped (e.g., /target).

mirror.description: Mirror URL (http://, ftp://, file://, or ssh://). Empty string defaults to http://ftp.debian.org/debian.
